accepted.domain: Odd N >= 3, K=Q(omega_N), primitive root supplied, characteristic zero.
accepted.individual_scalar_bank_minimum: (N+1)/2 over an algebraic closure; fixed P and no separate diagonal correction.
accepted.full_B_upper_bound: N+1 nonzero Green occurrences plus one diagonal occurrence.

clarifications: Individual branch roots need not lie in K; only the root-free summed implementation is guaranteed over K.
Finite-field full-target controls require 1+NG != 0 separately; N=3 over F7 is a verified singular exception.

constructive_addendum.free_diagonal_exact_criterion: With m=(N-1)/2, minimum m iff unique shifted Prony polynomial has simple nonzero nonresonant roots, otherwise m+1.
constructive_addendum.all_N_3_mod_4: Minimum remains (N+1)/2 because the shifted polynomial has the forbidden root 1.
constructive_addendum.N5: Minimum two nonzero branches plus a diagonal, via z^2-(1+omega^sigma)z+1.
constructive_addendum.next_open_question: Classify squarefreeness and nonresonance of shifted Gaussian-binomial polynomial for N=1 mod 4.

novelty: Publication-level novelty unverified; established Prony, moment, orthogonality, and Gaussian-binomial tools.
